subject: journey/odyssey
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single landscape 3:2 illustration for an Odyssey journey sketchbook card: departure from Troy, Homer Odyssey Book 9. Odysseus is a weathered olive-skinned Aegean man about forty, wiry strong build, curly dark hair, short square dark beard, prominent nose, undyed short wool tunic, faded rust-red cloak fastened at shoulder. He leans forward hauling a mooring rope into a low wooden Bronze Age Aegean ship with a single square sail and one bank of oars; other ships and distant ruined Troy sketched lightly behind. Close human action, readable hands and rope. Visible graphite construction lines, quick sepia ink, loose hatching and sparse uneven watercolour washes of ochre, grey-green and faded blue. An unfinished explorer's journal page, irregular edges fading into slightly foxed cream paper, no frame or binding. Small separate study of a rope knot. Imagined literary scene with plausible Bronze Age equipment, no classical triremes or Roman armour, no modern objects. No text, lettering, numbers, captions, signatures or watermark anywhere.
